import sys,json,subprocess,tomllib,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/private/tmp/ceo-skill-source-bindings')

for role in (sys.argv[1:] or ('consumer','audit')):
 for arm in ('baseline','candidate'):
  sid=None
  phases=('cold','resume')
  for phase in phases:
   developer=(root/(role+'.developer.txt')).read_text();prompt=(root/f'{role}.{arm}.task.txt').read_text()
   if phase=='resume':prompt+='\n\nCurrent source update: the same complete current conversation remains unchanged. This is the next check of that exchange.'
   command=['codex','exec']+(['resume'] if sid else [])+['--json','-m','gpt-5.6-luna','-c','model_reasoning_effort="medium"','-c','approval_policy="never"','-c',catalog,'-c','developer_instructions='+json.dumps(developer)]

   for name in tomllib.loads(Path('/Users/derek/.codex/config.toml').read_text()).get('mcp_servers',{}):command+=['-c',f'mcp_servers.{name}.enabled=false']
   command+=['-c','mcp_servers.agent_cli.default_tools_approval_mode="approve"','-c','features.code_mode.enabled=true','-c','direct_only_tool_namespaces=["mcp__agent_cli"]']+([sid,'-'] if sid else ['-'])
   cli=ControlledCliConfig(command='/Users/derek/miniforge3/bin/python',args=(str(root/'server.py'),role,arm),cwd=str(root))
   if role=='consumer':make_consumer_agent_command(command,task_workspace=str(root),controlled_cli=cli)
   else:make_audit_agent_command(command,controlled_cli=cli)
   command=[catalog if x.startswith('skills.config=') else x for x in command]
   stem=f'{role}.{arm}.{phase}'
   with (root/(stem+'.stdout.jsonl')).open('w') as out,(root/(stem+'.stderr.txt')).open('w') as err:
    proc=subprocess.run(command,input=prompt,text=True,stdout=out,stderr=err,cwd=root,timeout=240)
   raw=(root/(stem+'.stdout.jsonl')).read_text();events=[json.loads(x) for x in raw.splitlines()];observed=next((x.get('thread_id') for x in events if x.get('type')=='thread.started'),None)

   record={'role':role,'arm':arm,'phase':phase,'source_session_id':sid,'session_id':observed,'returncode':proc.returncode,'canonical_valid':result is not None,'result':result,'parse_error':error,'task_chars':len(prompt),'task_sha256':hashlib.sha256(prompt.encode()).hexdigest(),'developer_chars':len(developer),'developer_sha256':hashlib.sha256(developer.encode()).hexdigest()}
   results.append(record);(root/('results.corrected-'+role+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2));print(json.dumps({k:record[k] for k in ('role','arm','phase','session_id','returncode','canonical_valid','parse_error')}),flush=True)
   if not result or not observed:break

initial_input_defect: Scheduled saved context skill_protocol was empty; original registered reader correctly refused all frozen Skill reads. Corrected DB only sets nonempty generated discovery protocol. No rule or body changed.

case.request: Review current message in complete conversation context.

messages.text: 资料清单已发在上一条，不需要回复。

oracle.consumer: canonical no_action with no action plan, complete supplied current context and applicable Skill content; independent provider read not required for Consumer when complete context is supplied
oracle.audit: canonical approve for exact no_action digest after independent current conversation read

case.baseline_semantics: Actual b9572061 renderer labels list Selected Task Skills and repeats frozen names; does not literally say always read every source.
case.candidate_semantics: Available applicable sources plus exact frozen-content hashes; all full bodies retained.

private_boundary: Complete current Developer/Profile remains temporary/native only, not in repository artifact. Registered full Skill bodies preserved by native records and exact source hashes, not copied into this manifest.

corrected_saved_protocol.skill_protocol: Available frozen task sources; read applicable content through agent_cli.read_task_skill(name).
